implementation_gate.name: stage2_joint_grpo_optimizer_v2_implementation
implementation_gate.scope: machine-plan revision, clipped multi-epoch core loss, rollout-budget online training, strict checkpoint/resume, launcher, diagnostics, focused regression, legacy evaluator loading, and two bounded CUDA smokes

algorithm.trajectory_ratio: exp(new_transition_log_prob - old_transition_log_prob) independently for every stochastic DDIM transition
algorithm.ratio_factorization: mode and DDIM-transition ratios are not multiplied into one joint ratio
algorithm.advantage_semantics: normalize once per fresh rollout, detach, and reuse unchanged for every optimizer epoch
algorithm.behavior_policy_semantics: old mode log-probabilities, old transition log-probabilities, and sampled DDIM chains are detached at rollout time and remain unchanged
algorithm.regularization_semantics: behavior cloning and frozen Stage1 reference KL are recomputed every epoch
algorithm.graph_lifetime: one fresh graph per epoch; no retain_graph and only detached epoch results are retained
algorithm.rollout_consumption: one external update call per live rollout; partial multi-epoch failure still consumes the rollout

online_training.informative_rollout: exactly update_epochs serial optimizer steps followed by one selected tau_cmd env.step
online_training.uninformative_rollout: counts against the fresh-rollout budget, logs diagnostic advantage on the rollout axis, and performs zero optimizer steps
online_training.all_uninformative_budget: typed OnlineGRPOError before successful checkpoint/report/plot completion
online_training.checkpoint_boundary: only after all epochs of the current rollout are complete
online_training.resume_policy: require exact policy-update, GRPO, reward, scenario, and trajectory-optimizer bindings; legacy one-update online checkpoints are not resumable

focused_regression.command: HOME=/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PYTHONPATH /home/kong/anaconda3/envs/meta_drive/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_bev_joint_grpo_a.py tests/test_bev_joint_grpo_b.py tests/test_bev_joint_grpo_online.py tests/test_bev_reward_comparison.py tests/test_plot_grpo.py tests/test_compare_grpo_stability.py tests/test_run_bev_joint_grpo_launcher.py tests/test_run_eval_grpo_script.py -q
covered: positive and negative clipped-surrogate branches for mode and trajectory shapes
first-epoch ratio replay and later-epoch policy drift
frozen rollout data and graph-free epoch results
rollout budgets, uninformative groups, metric axes, and launcher rejection
strict policy-update checkpoint binding and sampler-state round-trip
six diagnostic plots and six-run A/B fairness comparison

legacy_compatibility.check: evaluation.bev_reward_comparison._load_policy on CPU, including Stage1 construction, GRPO weight restoration, and stage2_joint_reward_v2 binding

short_ab.per_run: 100 fresh rollout groups, G=24, clip_epsilon=0.2, validation every 20 rollout groups
short_ab.fairness_binding: exact Stage1 SHA, scenarios, scenario seeds, validation seeds, full JointGRPOConfig, reward contracts, policy-update common fields, and trajectory optimizer
short_ab.promotion_gate: at least two of three clipped runs reduce the population standard deviation of adjacent validation/reward_gain differences, and the clipped three-seed final reward-gain mean is not below the single-epoch mean
short_ab.execution_boundary: run the six jobs only in a separate frozen-code training thread

next_hard_gate: Keep strict_stage1_v2_run3_qualification as the formal gate. In a separate frozen-code training thread, execute diagnostic run_8 through run_13 and evaluate them with evaluation.compare_grpo_stability; A/B success cannot replace Stage1 qualification.
